svg.title: URTC-GATEWAY architecture
svg.desc: URTC-GATEWAY listens on a TCP port, lets only the identifiers a host may send cross towards the CAN bus, checks the payload against the protocol specification, limits the rate and requires a peer to prove it holds a key with an HMAC over a connection nonce and a counter. It is tested with fakes and a local socket; it has never been connected to a real bus.

svg.text: A gateway in front of the CAN bus: an identifier list, a payload check, a rate limit and a session key.
